title: ee.agentsmd.drift.v1
description: AGENTS.md bridge drift diagnostic (ADR 0065 §5). Emitted under data by `ee diag agentsmd-drift`. Read-only and advisory: reports stale exports (managed-block generation behind the DB generation), file-vs-memory contradictions in the conflict-surface vocabulary, and memory rules absent from the file, with suggested commands. Never mutates.

status.description: ok for a completed diagnostic; file_missing when the bridge target is absent.

file.description: Workspace-relative bridge target path (AGENTS.md by default).

dbGeneration.description: Current workspace DB generation the managed block is compared against.

managedBlock.description: Managed-block freshness summary; null when the file has no managed block.

generation.description: generation= attribute on the begin marker; null when unparseable.

stale.description: true when the block generation is behind the current DB generation (or unparseable).

hashMatches.description: false when the recorded body hash no longer matches the block bytes (hand-edited).

contradictions.description: Hand-written statements that pair with a high-confidence procedural rule on the same topic with opposite polarity.

missingRules.description: Primer-selected memory rules with no sufficiently similar statement anywhere in the file (managed block included).

line.description: The primer-rendered rule line (with the short provenance ref).

suggestedCommands.description: Advisory follow-up commands; the diagnostic itself never mutates.

degraded.description: Standard ee.response.v2 degraded entries (agentsmd_file_missing, agentsmd_markers_missing, agentsmd_unmanaged_edit_detected).
